pass_a_gloss:
The seraphim allow Longinus to glorify and the cherubim do not oppose him, he utters a sacred voice, a hymn, mystical, and victorious, saying 'Truly this was the Son of God', which exists before the ages and will have forever, making the ages old, yet remaining unchanged, with an eternal kingdom and uncorrupted power, to whom is the glory and power forever.
which is before the ages has and into ages shall have
pass_b_english: The seraphim allow Longinus to glorify and the cherubim do not oppose him as he sings a hymn; he himself utters a sacred voice, a hymn-singer, a bearer of a trophy, mystical, and victorious: 'Truly this was the Son of God' (Matthew 27:54), which is before the ages, possesses, and will possess forever. He himself makes the ages old, yet he himself remains unchanged; for his kingdom is an eternal kingdom and his power will never be corrupted (Daniel 4:3), to him belongs the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
